name: Bugsink
description: Error tracking for your apps that works with the Sentry SDKs

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Bugsink's SQLite databases with your projects, issues and events, plus the secret key. Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Bugsink web app and the error ingest API, published on host as 7008

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: BASE_URL
variables.description: The address you open Bugsink at. Replace YOUR-SERVER-IP with your server IP address, like http://192.168.1.20:7008, or the page shows 400 Bad Request. It is also the address in your DSNs.

variables.name: ADMIN_EMAIL
variables.description: The email you sign in with as the first admin.

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: Leave blank and IceStore makes a password on first start and shows it in the app's log under CREDENTIALS. Only used for the first account.
